name: Hotel de Rome
positioning: Rocco Forte hotel in a neoclassical 19th-century former bank on Bebelplatz in the historic heart of East Berlin
best_for: Travelers who want to stay steps from the Opera House and Unter den Linden
Guests who enjoy historic buildings with original bank details

facts.text: The hotel is housed in a neoclassical 19th-century bank building.
The hotel is located on Bebelplatz in the historic heart of East Berlin.
The hotel is steps from the Opera House and Unter den Linden, and a short walk to the Humboldt Forum and Museum Island.
The lobby has a contemporary design with a pink neon birdcage as its centerpiece.
Front rooms overlook Bebelplatz, the dome of St. Hedwig's Cathedral and the Opera House.
The Royal Bebel Suite has high ceilings and a wraparound balcony.
Bathrooms feature mosaic tiles, heated floors, a separate bathtub and shower, and Irene Forte Skincare products.
CHIARO restaurant serves an Italian menu in cooperation with chef Fulvio Pierangelini.
Afternoon tea is served in the marble-columned Opera Court.
Guests can request a Rocco Forte Nourish mini-bar in advance, stocked with healthy snacks and drinks.

highlights.text: The heated indoor pool sits in the bank's former jewelry vault, surrounded by original marble columns and mosaic tiles.
The chandeliered ballroom was once the bank's cashier's hall.
The Historic Banker Suite is a former bank conference room with parquet floors and oak-paneled walls.
From late spring into early autumn, guests can have cocktails on the Rooftop Terrace or the Hedwig Terrace, both with views of the Opera House, Berlin Cathedral and the TV Tower.
On weekends from late November through mid-December, the Rooftop Terrace becomes a heated winter lounge with mulled wine.

considerations.text: Breakfast is not included in room rates.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the hotel's exclusive positioning.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Hotel de Rome, A Rocco Forte Hotel
